approaches.title: Greedy maximum-heap decrement
approaches.summary: Store absolute differences in a max-heap and repeatedly reduce the largest difference by one. Both revisions are marked wrong.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Pop the largest difference, decrement it, and push it back for each available move; marked wrong (TLE).

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2333!: still tle but semantic improvements
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Decrement the largest difference in place with `peek_mut` instead of popping and reinserting; marked wrong (still TLE).

approaches.title: Sorted plateau leveling
approaches.summary: Sort differences in descending order and use bulk reductions to level the largest values, then distribute any remaining moves. This avoids processing each move individually.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replace per-move heap updates with sorted plateau leveling and bulk arithmetic; marked correct.
